title: Карточка товара в каталоге: метки наличия и скидки, старая цена, добавление в корзину из списка, «показать ещё»
order: Bring the catalog product card up to the level every InSales and Tilda store template shows: a price block that displays the old (struck-through) price next to the discounted one, status and promo badges (В наличии / Нет в наличии / Новинка / Скидка −N%), an add-to-cart control on the card itself, and a «Показать ещё» button that appends the next page without a full reload.
build: `modules/products/components/product-price` and `modules/home/components/product-card`: render the original price struck through whenever a promotion or a compare-at price applies, plus the discount percentage.

A `ProductBadges` component (new, under `modules/products/components`) driven by data already on the product: stock quantity, `created_at` (Новинка within N days, N from a constant), active promotion. No new backend fields.

Add-to-cart control on the card in `/store` and in a category listing, reusing `modules/home/components/add-to-bag-button`; a product with several variants opens the product page instead of guessing a variant.
`modules/store/components/pagination`: keep the numbered pages for SEO and add a «Показать ещё» button that appends the next page client-side.
measure: Local stand per AGENTS.md; a product with a promotion shows the struck-through price and the −N% badge; a product with zero stock shows «Нет в наличии» and its add-to-cart control is disabled.
Screenshots of /ru/store at 390 and 1440 px, before and after, into artifacts/docs/<id>/.
`pnpm --filter @dtc/gorgo-medusa-storefront typecheck` and the storefront unit suite green — quote the result lines.

title: Выдача каталога: фильтр по цене, «только в наличии», сортировка по популярности и рейтингу, признак наличия в ответе
order: The storefront cannot offer the filters every InSales demo has because the catalog query does not support them. Add the four capabilities to the tenant catalog API, each covered by a test.
build: `min_price` / `max_price` query parameters, plus an endpoint (or an extra field on the category response) returning the actual price bounds of the current selection so the UI can size a slider.
`in_stock=true` — only variants with a positive inventory quantity.

Sort orders `popularity` (by the number of sold units over the last 90 days) and `rating` (by the average review score from the product-review module) next to the existing `created_at` / `price_asc` / `price_desc`.
An `availability` field on every product in the catalog response so the card can render a status without a second request.
Tenant scoping stays as in the neighbouring routes (`api/tenants/tenant-scope.ts`); nothing here may leak another tenant's data.
measure: Integration tests over the new parameters, including the tenant-isolation case, in the suite AGENTS.md prescribes for backend routes.
curl against the local stand for each parameter, with the command and its output in the PR body.
No migration that drops or rewrites data; if a schema change is needed, `pg_dump` first.

title: Фильтры и сортировка каталога на витрине: цена диапазоном, «только в наличии», расширенные сортировки, счётчики
order: Expose on the storefront what tp03 added to the API, in the shape InSales demos use: a filter panel with price from/to, an in-stock toggle, a wider sort list, a product counter and a «Сбросить» control.
build: `modules/store/components/refinement-list`: a price range control (two numeric inputs plus a slider) initialised from the bounds the API returns.
An «Только в наличии» switch and a «Сбросить» button that clears every facet at once.
`modules/store/components/sort-select`: add «по популярности» and «по рейтингу», keeping the existing three.
The number of found products next to the filters, and the count of matching items next to each facet value (the attribute facets already return counts).
Every filter state must live in the URL so a filtered listing can be shared and indexed.
measure: Local stand: filter, sort, share the URL, reload — the same selection comes back. Screenshots at 390 and 1440 px.
Typecheck and unit suite green; result lines quoted in the PR.

title: Блоки доверия как данные магазина: преимущества, вопросы-ответы, соцсети, отзывы о магазине (API + панель)
order: The four blocks every competitor home page carries cannot be built on the storefront because the shop has nowhere to store them. Add them as tenant data with an owner screen and a public read endpoint.
build: Advantages: an ordered list of up to 6 items (icon key, title, text) on the tenant's home document.
FAQ: an ordered list of question/answer pairs, tenant-wide; the storefront will render an accordion.
Social links: a map of network → URL in tenant settings.

Store reviews: a review about the SHOP (author, text, rating, date, moderation flag) — a sibling of the existing product-review module (`apps/backend/src/modules/product-review`), reusing its moderation idiom rather than inventing a second one.
Public read through `api/store/tenant/...` the way `home`, `pages` and `articles` already do, with revalidation of the storefront on write.
measure: Integration tests per resource, including tenant isolation and the moderation flag.
Owner screens in `apps/tenant-panel` reachable from the navigation; a short screencast or screenshots of creating one item of each kind.
curl of each public endpoint with output in the PR body.

title: Витрина: блоки преимуществ, FAQ, соцсетей и отзывов о магазине + починка заглушек композиции (hero k, hero l, подвал f4)
order: Render the tp05 data as home-page blocks inside our existing composition corridor, and close a measured defect: three of the corridor's choices are silent placeholders.
build: Blocks for advantages (3-4 tiles), FAQ (accordion), social links and store reviews, each self-suppressing when the shop has no data — the idiom `ProfileHero`/`CategoryTiles` already use.

Each new block becomes a named option of the composition document (`apps/storefront/src/lib/theme/composition.ts`) with a plain-language label and a next-intl key, the way the existing options are done.

MEASURED DEFECT to fix: `modules/home/variants/index.ts` maps hero `k` and `l` to `ProfileHero`, and `modules/layout/templates/footer/variants/index.ts` maps footer `f4` to `FooterF1`. The owner picks «Карусель с соседями»/«Инвертированный, с рассылкой» and silently gets something else. Implement the three variants, or remove them from the vocabulary — never leave a choice that lies. The f4 newsletter form needs the endpoint from tp09; if tp09 is not merged yet, ship f4 with the form disabled and say so in the PR, do not map it to another footer.
measure: On the local stand, switch every composition option one by one and confirm the storefront actually changes; a screenshot per new block.
A check (test or script) asserting that every key of the composition vocabulary maps to its OWN component — so this defect cannot come back silently.

title: Заказ в один клик и предзаказ: ручки создания заказа без корзины и покупки товара с нулевым остатком, уведомление владельцу
order: «Купить в 1 клик» appears in 7 of 19 InSales templates and pre-order in 10 of 19 — for a Russian shop both are baseline. Neither exists in our backend.
build: An endpoint that creates an order from one variant plus a contact (name + phone, email optional), without a cart, in a status that means «ожидает подтверждения» — the owner calls back to confirm.
Pre-order: allow adding to cart and ordering a variant with zero stock when the shop has enabled it, and mark such a line as a pre-order in the order.
Both must notify the owner through the channel that already exists (`api/tenants/notification-settings`, including its telegram branch) and the customer by email through `modules/smtp-notification`.
A per-tenant switch for each of the two behaviours; default off, so no shop gets them by surprise.
measure: Integration tests: order created from one variant; pre-order of a zero-stock variant; both switches off → the endpoint refuses.
A live call against the local stand with the request and response in the PR body.
Owner notification actually delivered on the stand (log line or received message quoted).

title: Витрина: быстрый просмотр товара в модальном окне, кнопка «Купить в 1 клик», свёртка длинного описания
order: Add the three product-page mechanics our catalog lacks. The long-description one is not theoretical: on the live store the мумиё description prints as one uninterrupted wall of text.
build: Quick view: a modal opened from a catalog card showing gallery, price, variants and add-to-cart without leaving the listing; the page URL must stay shareable (a route-intercepting modal or a query parameter, your call — say which and why).
«Купить в 1 клик»: a short form (name + phone) on the product page and inside quick view, posting to the tp07 endpoint, with a clear success state.
Pre-order state on a zero-stock product when the shop enabled it.
Product description: collapse past ~12 lines with «Показать полностью» / «Свернуть», with the full text present in the DOM so it stays indexable.
measure: Local stand, in a browser: open quick view from the listing, order in one click, see the order in the owner panel. Screenshots of each step.
The мумиё product page before/after the collapse, at 390 px.
Typecheck and unit suite green.

title: Публичные формы магазина: подписка на рассылку, обратный звонок, заявка — хранение, антиспам, доставка владельцу
order: Our storefront has no public form at all except checkout, which is why the footer variant «с рассылкой» is a placeholder. Add the three forms as one small subsystem, with anti-spam from the start.
build: Newsletter subscription: email + consent flag + source page, deduplicated per tenant; owner sees and exports the list.
Callback request and generic lead form: contact fields plus a free-text message, tied to a page or product when one is given.
Anti-spam on every public form (a captcha provider or an equivalent, with the key in tenant settings); rate limiting per IP. The moment a public form exists this stops being optional.
Delivery to the owner over the existing notification settings (email and telegram), and an owner screen listing what arrived.
measure: Integration tests: submission, duplicate suppression, anti-spam rejection, tenant isolation.
Live submission on the stand delivering a notification — quote the log line or the message.
curl of each endpoint in the PR body.

title: Витрина: настоящая форма рассылки в подвале F4, формы обратного звонка и заявки, баннер согласия на cookie
order: Render the tp09 forms on the storefront and add the cookie-consent banner a Russian shop needs.
build: Footer F4 gets its real newsletter form (this is the variant that today silently renders F1).
A «Заказать звонок» control in the header and a lead form block usable on a content page.
Cookie consent banner: shown once, remembered per browser, with a link to the shop's privacy page; it must not cover the buy button on a phone.
Every form shows its own error and success state inline; a failed submit must never look like a success (rule 20a).
measure: Local stand: submit each form and see it arrive in the owner panel; screenshots.
The banner at 390 px with the product page behind it, showing the buy button is still reachable.
Typecheck and unit suite green.

title: Витрина: избранное и сравнение товаров со счётчиками в шапке и отдельными страницами
order: Comparison appears in 10 of 19 InSales templates and a wishlist in 8 — they are the two most common catalog features we lack entirely.
build: Wishlist and comparison lists kept per browser (localStorage) so a guest can use both, with counters in the header.
A wishlist page and a comparison page; comparison shows the shop's own attributes (`api/tenants/product-attributes`) as rows, hiding rows where all products agree, with a switch to show them.
For a signed-in customer the wishlist should survive a device change — if that needs backend storage, do NOT add it here: name it in the PR as the follow-up task and ship the local version.
Both lists must tolerate a product that has since disappeared (rule 20a: a client-held id is a cache of foreign state).
measure: Local stand: add three products to comparison, see the differing rows, remove one, reload — state survives. Screenshots.
A deleted product in the list does not break the page — show it.
Typecheck and unit suite green.

title: SEO-поля товара, категории и страницы, произвольные ключи страниц магазина, пер-тенантный счётчик аналитики
order: Three measured gaps that block a real shop: no editable meta fields, a hardcoded list of page keys (so an owner cannot create «Доставка и оплата», which half the InSales demos have), and one analytics id shared by every storefront in the image.
build: meta title / meta description / slug on product, category and shop page, editable in the owner panel and used by the storefront head (the JSON-LD and canonical logic already exists).

`tenant_page` today accepts only `contacts|legal|about|privacy|offer` (`modules/tenant/models/tenant-page.ts`). Allow owner-defined keys with a slug, keeping the five known ones working and their footer links intact.
A per-tenant analytics counter (GA4 and Яндекс.Метрика ids in tenant settings) replacing the single build-time `NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID`, which today points every tenant at one property.
measure: Integration tests for the new fields and the page-key change, including that the five legacy keys still resolve.
On the stand: set a meta title, load the page, read it back out of the HTML — quote the curl and the output.
Set a counter id for one tenant and show it is absent on another tenant's storefront.
